item.title: Version 3.7.1
item.description: - **Edit term on one screen:** a term's name and dates, then each course with its class times, plus Add course and Import schedule. Everything saves together, and one Undo takes it all back. - **Classes show their course name:** a class time with no title shows its course instead of "Class", in Schedule, Calendar, Today, reminders and search. - **Importing a schedule puts classes in the right term:** classes go into the term their dates fall in (or the one you're editing), match only that term's courses, and importing the same file again doesn't add duplicates. - **The Assistant and Ross plan terms:** they can add a course to a named term like Spring 2027, and a Tuesday/Thursday class in one step. - **Calendar crosses out finished work:** done assignments stay, crossed out, and so does the same item from Canvas or your calendar. Right-click to mark done.
